text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Doto, Opera O,
Ayabe, let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Grab the flag planted in the sand!
"Beach Flags"... ready, set, GO!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Teyaaaaaaaaaaaaah!

Meisho Doto leaps out first.
Her core strength is noticeably improved. However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, that flag is none other than my kingdom's banner!
I shall seize it and make my majesty known to the world!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —I won't give it up. The autumn crown, above all else!

text_block_list.name: Opera O & Ayabe
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaahhh!!
HAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm so exhausted... *faint*...
Blown away effortlessly... With a lack of spirit, it wasn't even a contest. The backs of those two were still far away...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, today has been quite fulfilling.
At this rate, the future looks bright for my Supreme Overlord Army.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: There's no such thing as an "Overlord Army." Not really.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-If you could just place me, um~,
in the corner next to Tanuki-san, that'd be~...

text_block_list.name: Tanuki
text_block_list.text: Whuff, whuff...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Legions don't matter. This autumn, I'm the one who will win.
Against both you and Doto.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Autumn, huh? Good grief... Ayabe-san,
are your eyes still fixed on such a place?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The autumn chrysanthemums are right before us, yes.
Yet surely there are other things to behold as well?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What you should look at? Well, that would be...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying. After autumn comes winter.
And beyond that, a new spring.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"That is an unknown act for us!
In other words, the 'Season of United Battle'!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Joint front...? 
Does that mean we'll do our best together~?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Yes, once the Classic Triple Crown is over, the Senior Class awaits beyond. In other words—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A freedom stage featuring the older generation!
A great era of fierce intergenerational rivalry!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
We must seize victory there.
Against the 'Golden Generation' just above us.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The Golden Generation. Special Week-san, Grass Wonder-san, and the others...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Indeed. At first, I intended to take them on all by myself. However—I've changed my mind."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Destiny turned out far better than I thought.
After all, among my generation, there was a shining star
who wouldn't easily concede supremacy to me."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Won't you leave it behind with me? Our generation's
immortal hoofprints, etched into the galaxy of Umamusume history.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of relying on anyone.
However, without a gathering of many stars,
there are revues that simply cannot be staged!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, Doto. This is a golden opportunity. By all means, look ahead to a future where you battle alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I don't intend to fight alongside you.
But—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I cannot lose.
No matter who my opponent is.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, if you wish to act the soloist,
that is fine as well. Even solos, when layered together,
can spark a revolution.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto, how about you? Are you prepared to bear one of our wings and become a friend of ABC?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(I want to get... stronger... Strong enough
to be of help to the Opera O-san I respect so much,
and the cool Ayabe-san...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Yet I... have nothing.
No desire to bring light to everyone, or running for a late sister... Nothing like that...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll cheer for youuu!
Right beside the two of you... with all my might!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I see, I see! Well, sticking to the chorus for a while wouldn't hurt either. Hwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: And so, that's what happened...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. Trainer, what Doto-san is lacking after all is...
choice_data_list: It's the thought that counts, right?

text_block_list.text:
You need to strengthen your mind along with your body.
Not giving up is a great virtue, but on top of that,
confidence and ambition are also essential.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, divine revelation!
I just had a great idea, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Why don't we try doing something at this summer festival that'll help build up some courage?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: If you take the plunge and leap from the Kiyomizu stage and land it, you might be able to shed your old self too, Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Getting guts...? You mean, becoming like
Opera O-san or Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If that's so...
Trainer, I want to try it out~.

True, letting them do what they'd normally do might
be a good idea. What should we have them do?
choice_data_list: Giving a Speech Atop the Yagura

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A speech... So I just need to climb up that Bon dance tower and say something, right? Understood~

Meisho Doto climbed up onto the festival tower.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Auuugh, it's so high up. There are so many people~
But I have to say something cool like Opera O-san.
Umm...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!
Behold, everyone, look at those fireworks...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: No matter how you look at it, no matter what~~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It's firewoooorks!!
(BOOOM!)
"The passionate speech... fell completely flat. But her voice was strong, echoing right from the bottom of her belly."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "My own star... Yes, I hope I can find a star to swear upon too, just like Ayabe-san."
And so, we decided to start by finding Meisho Doto's star of destiny.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Doto-san, why not go big? What about the "moon" over there? It's an extra-large portion size, after all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: N-No, I'd like one that's a bit smaller...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Over to the right, there's a sparkling star...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll go with the tiny one next to the one
next to it, the one you can barely even see~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I just can't bring myself to treat you like a stranger...
Even if you're small, let's do our best.
I'll do my best too...

True to Meisho Doto, her star of destiny was modest.
Yet, through that humble vow, she seemed filled with fighting spirit.
